verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents a native subscription analytics page built on its own billing data ('Monitor overall performance at a glance', with benchmarking against similar businesses), so analytics come from the billing system rather than a BI export. However, the evidence never names MRR, churn, cohort retention or LTV, and one community team said Recurly's analytics was something Stripe lacked, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MRR, churn, cohort retention and LTV metrics; detail on how the metrics are computed; independent or hands-on corroboration of the analytics.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
